<|) Rounding strategy
You can round decimals in many ways to the nearest Hundredth, Tenth, Ones (unit), Ten,
Hundred and so on.

Notes for parents :
+ Remind your child to round up if the digit to the right of the place value he/she wants to round is equal
to or greater than 5, and round down if it is less than 5.
